perks.name: Well Prepared
perks.description: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
perks.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup: 
Grants a stack of Armor Charge.

Each Armor Charge stack grants +10 Health Stat.
Grants up to +30 Health Stat with x3 Armor Charge.
Maxes out at +60 Health Stat with x6 Armor Charges.

perks.name: Down the Line
perks.description: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a hit against Miniboss+ Combatants:
Grants a stack of Down the Line, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. 
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between gaining stacks.

Down the Line:
15% increased Weapon Damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.
Consumes a stack upon killing Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.

item.name: Stacks on Stacks
item.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants you 1 additional stack of Armor Charge.
item.exact: All sources of Armor Charge now grant an additional stack unless explicitly stated not to.

item.name: Weapons Font
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
While Armor Charge is active:

+20 | +40 | +50 Weapons.

item.name: Harmonic Scavenger
item.description: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
